views.name: The GDHCN trust network
views.documentation: The GDHCN trust network, the home page's figure (input/images/trust_network.png) with every box where the figure draws it: 1. Onboard (a country's certificate authority submits its public key to the trust anchor), 2. Distribute (the anchor distributes the verified public keys to every member) and 3. Verify (any member verifies the provenance of a document signed by any other). Each box links its actor or concept in this guide.
